messages:
noah: Heads up team 1: external pentest vendor (Securify) scheduled for next Tuesday against staging. They request Encrypt/Decrypt on a single test KMS key + an assume-role for API calls. Proposing a 3-hr corridor 10:30-13:30 PDT. Any showstoppers?

izzy: Sounds good. Important: Legal asked for audit retention 365 days for this vendor engagement because of customer-data scope. Confirmed?

carmen: 365d is longer than our usual 90/180. Ops can we make the CloudTrail export immutable for 365d for this run only?

ops-bot: automated: scheduling CloudTrail export to s3://secure-archive/pt/4256789012 at 13:40 PDT, retention immutable=365d (requested by izzy).

infra: We can spin up a dedicated test key and two roles: one limited test role (kms:Encrypt,kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:666666:key/staging-securify-key) and a read-only trail viewer for reviewers. We'll add IP restrictions and TTL 3600s on the test role. Example assume flow for vendor:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::666666:role/securify-pt-stager --role-session-name securify --duration-seconds 3600
```
I'll open a tiny terraform PR and tag reviewers.

noah: Good. Carmen + Izzy: please coordinate on whether decrypt is absolutely needed. If encrypt-only suffices we should prefer that.

izzy: Vendor claims they need decrypt for exploitation checks. We'll allow decrypt but lock the key policy to explicitly deny kms:PutKeyPolicy, kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion, kms:DisableKey. Also deny kms:TagResource to avoid metadata chaos.

carmen: I'll draft the key policy snippet and post it in the PR. Also: dont rotate the key during the corridor or evidence gets invalidated.

infra: Confirmed. We'll mark the key as non-rotatable until the engagement completes. Also adding an ephemeral tag that says "pt-run=4256789012" so we can query artifacts easily.

noah: Evidence plan: for each finding include CloudTrail event ids (kms and sts), request/response captures, VPC flow logs for exposed sources, and app traces with trace ids. Use label "securify-4256789012" in ticket metadata.

izzy: For triaging, please follow vuln bucket rules: Critical -> immediate PD page + emergency runbook; High -> notify oncall and create remediation sprint; Medium/Low -> normal triage cadence and assign to squad. Retest SLA: vendor will re-run specific tests within 3 business days after we mark fixes verified. Keep retest slot to 2 hours per finding group.

carmen: Operational constraint: No broad RBAC edits during corridor. Temporary mitigations must be PR'd and fast-approved by izzy + noah. No wildcard "*" allow statements.

infra: Quick sample IAM snippet well include in PR for the role policy:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:666666:key/staging-securify-key"},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["sts:AssumeRole"],"Resource":"arn:aws:iam::666666:role/securify-pt-stager"}
  ]
}
```
We'll also create an explicit deny in the key policy for destructive actions.

noah: Alarms: set CloudWatch metric for >60 kms:Decrypt calls/min from single principal -> alert to #eng-security; page only for sustained >150/min and unusual error rates. This avoids noisy PDs.

ops-bot: automated: bridge created -> https://infra.company/bridges/securify-4256789012 (created by ops-bot)

izzy: Evidence S3 path convention: s3://secure-archive/pt/4256789012/{finding-id}/. All objects marked immutable for 365d. Carmen, ensure internal access controls to that bucket are limited to security and compliance.

carmen: Will do. Also prepping a minimal repro template for findings: 1) Title, 2) Affected resource ARNs, 3) Steps to reproduce, 4) Request/response pairs, 5) CloudTrail event ids, 6) Observed impact, 7) Suggested remediation, 8) Proposed retest window. I'll attach the template to the triage board.

infra: Deploy freeze recommended 10:00-14:00 in staging to reduce unrelated noise. We'll post a note in #releases and annotate the infra PR.

noah: One more thing: if vendor performs noisy key enumeration we should throttle and move them to a read-only test mode. Set a temporary managed policy that removes Decrypt if rate thresholds are exceeded. Can infra script that?

infra: Yes, we can add a small Lambda that watches CloudWatch alarms and swaps a protective policy (deny kms:Decrypt) onto the stager role for a cooldown period. We'll include that as an optional mitigation flag in the PR.

legal: Quick note: legal approves 365d retention for this engagement but requests a short written attestation from the vendor about no export of cloud logs. Carmen/Izzy, please collect that and attach to folder.

noah: Great. Action items recap:
- infra: terraform role + key + IP whitelist + optional auto-throttle Lambda (PR by Fri EOD)
- carmen: key policy snippet, repro template, S3 access rules, collect vendor attestation (Wed)
- izzy: confirm decrypt necessity with vendor, triage rules + retest SLA doc (Wed)
- ops-bot/ops: confirm CloudTrail export timing & immutability (Wed)
- legal: vendor attestation received and stored (Wed)

infra: I'll open PR and drop link here when ready. Tagging reviewers for fast-track.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled Tue 09:00 PDT to confirm infra PR status (automated).

noah: If no objections by EOD Thursday we'll lock the corridor and proceed. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

izzy: No objections from me.

carmen: All good on my side.
